description: Estimate whether a RoutersUA order placed now ships today and by which date Nova Poshta usually delivers it, from the current time in Kyiv and the store's same-day cut-off: 17:30 Monday to Friday, 16:30 on Saturday, Sunday and public holidays. Use it when the user asks when an order would ship or arrive; for delivery points use routersua_find_delivery_points, and for delivery cost and payment methods routersua_get_store_policy. Transit usually takes 0 to 2 days after shipping; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Public holidays are not known to it; products on backorder ship from their backorder_ship_date instead.
name: routersua_estimate_delivery
title: Estimate RoutersUA dispatch and delivery
